lines.text: About eight days later, Jesus took Peter, John, and James up on a mountain to pray.
While Jesus prayed, His clothes became radiantly white, and Moses and Elijah spoke with Him about His departure at Jerusalem.
When Peter woke, he suggested putting up three towers, one for Jesus, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
A cloud enveloped them, and a voice from it said, "This is My Son, whom I have chosen. Stay with Him!"
After the voice spoke, only Jesus was present, and the disciples told no one what they had seen.
